answer: A beneficiary claim needs a death certificate attestation from an accepted issuer, checked against the owner identity on file. A forged or mismatched certificate is rejected, and the issuer record is kept for audit. A Sybil operator would need a valid certificate per fake identity, which cannot be mass-produced. One lantern proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. The pearl test catches the lazy fake and the trellis test catches the patient one.
